name: tia_get_library_type_instances
description: Read instances of an exact project-library type in one exact PLC scope. Optionally select an exact type-version GUID and/or exact OriginalLibrary source string; omitted version/source selectors include all versions of the unique selected type.

project_path.description: Exact full path of a project already open in the connected TIA Portal instance.

plc_name.description: Exact, ordinal-case-sensitive PLC software name providing the IInstanceSearchScope.

library_type_id.description: Exact GUID of a LibraryType visible in the selected project's ProjectLibrary.

version_id.description: Optional exact LibraryTypeVersion GUID. If omitted, instances are queried for all matching versions.
